response.overview: “Amor Tarahumara” is a short documentary produced in 2001 as a university project that explores the meaning of love within the Rarámuri (Tarahumara) culture of northern Mexico. Through reflections, interviews, and poetic narration, the film contrasts Western notions of romantic love with a broader, community-centered understanding rooted in shared life, mutual care, and spiritual connection. The documentary reveals how love, for the Rarámuri people, extends beyond the couple to include family, community, and collective well-being, offering a profound perspective on human relationships, cultural values, and the essence of coexistence.
response.title: Documentary Short Film "Amor Tarahumara" University Work 2001
